samples.summary: No test anywhere covers the new `dispose()` → `isDisposed()`/neutered-mutators behavior on a real editor
samples.evidence: The delta's core new behavior lives in `packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts`: `dispose()` now sets `disposed = true` and calls `neuterMutations(api)`, and `isDisposed()` is a new `EditorAPI` member. I grepped the whole repo's test files for `isDisposed`, `neuterMutations` and "disposed" — the only hits are the frontend `image-insert.test.ts` fake (`isDisposed: vi.fn().mockReturnValue(disposed)`), which mocks the very thing under test away. `packages/docs/test/view/editor-read-only.test.ts` exercises the read-only branch of `MUTATING_METHODS` (insertLink/insertTable/applyStyle) but nothing calls `dispose()` and then asserts `editor.isDisposed() === true` or that e.g. `insertTable`/`applyStyle`/`pasteFormat` are inert afterwards. If `dispose()` forgot the flag, forgot the `neuterMutations` call, or the ordering broke, every suite stays green while the stale-holder write this PR exists to block lands silently.

samples.summary: The new disposed guard in `insertImageFromUrl` has no test — the function is untested entirely
samples.evidence: `insertImageFromUrl` gained the same `editor.isDisposed()` check (returns false + toast). `packages/frontend/src/app/docs/image-insert.test.ts` only has describes for `shareTokenImageUploader` and `insertImageFromFile`; grepping `insertImageFromUrl` across packages/frontend finds only `image-insert.ts` and the `docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx` call site — no test file. So the URL-insert stale-editor path (and its `return false`, which the toolbar reads to decide whether to close the dialog) is unpinned.

samples.summary: The 'floor entry was rebuilt in place' fallback branch in `canUndo()` (identity usable, mark not found, stack below the cap) is untested
samples.evidence: `canUndo()` now has three outcomes after a failed `lastIndexOf`: latch-and-allow when `stack.length >= YORKIE_MAX_UNDO_DEPTH`, else fall through to `stack.length > this.undoFloorDepth`. The cap-overflow test at yorkie-doc-store.test.ts:371 covers only the latch path (it asserts the stack is exactly 50 first), and the new identity-instability test at :401 makes `undoFloorIdentityUsable` false so it never reaches this branch. Nothing constructs a below-cap stack whose floor entry is no longer identity-equal, so a wrong comparison there (over- or under-restrictive undo past the initial load) ships undetected.

samples.summary: The `undoFloorDepth = index + 1` refresh on a successful identity lookup is never observed by a test
samples.evidence: The comment claims the cached depth 'tracks entries shifting off the bottom instead of going stale'. No test makes the identity path succeed for a while (refreshing the depth as entries shift off) and then fall back to the depth comparison, so the refresh could be deleted and every test would still pass.

samples.summary: Disposed-editor test asserts only that `insertImage` was not called; the user-visible toast and `focus()` suppression are unasserted
samples.evidence: The new test checks `expect(editor.insertImage).not.toHaveBeenCalled()` but not the new `toast.error("Image not inserted: this document is no longer editable")` nor that `editor.focus()` is skipped. A silent early return (no feedback after a successful upload) would pass this test identically to the intended behavior.
